channel.title: Human-Centered Practice :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Re-checked against real course-design pages, 2026-08-04 — see resources/design-log.md. This resolves two rows Round 1 flagged (Requirements Analysis Task, Usability Evaluation): their previously-assumed endpoint didn’t map cleanly onto a real course, and cs.md’s own CIS 320 entry is explicit that CIS 320 carries only a bounded, every-student-gets-this-once exposure to acceptance-criteria/requirements work — “not a full requirements-gathering methodology” — with full depth deliberately deferred to a Software Architecture specialization elective, not the Year 3–4 general capstone this pass had guessed in Round 1.
